GREETING.english: Hi! 👋 I can help with grades, programs, admissions, or a campus visit. What would you like to know?
GREETING.roman_urdu: Assalam-o-alaikum! 👋 Grades, programs, admissions ya campus visit ke bare mein pooch sakte hain.
GREETING.urdu: السلام علیکم! 😊 میں آپ کی کیا مدد کر سکتا ہوں؟

THANKS.english: You’re welcome. Let me know if you need anything else.
THANKS.roman_urdu: Khushi hui 😊 Aur kisi info ki zarurat ho to bata dein.
THANKS.urdu: خوشی ہوئی۔ مزید معلومات چاہیے ہوں تو بتا دیں۔
